lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: At least four vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible on the mid-lateral flank. The columns contain between one and three spots each, forming a repeating grid-like spatial arrangement moving from the anterior to the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are observed intersecting the circular blobs, particularly evident in the mid-flank region where they align with the vertical spot columns.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature displays a sharp vertical gradient (light upper boundary, shadowed lower boundary) running along the upper third of the flank from the posterior base of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, horizontal linear mark is present on the upper flank, originating near the posterior insertion point of the first dorsal fin and extending posteriorly.
